trigger.plain: Buy today's daily close above the pivot high, a fresh new high from right under it.

decisions.wrong_if: A one-day reaction of one atr_14d off a day's high (C7, translated), or a daily close below entry less one atr_14d.
decisions.reason: The C5 shape: W and D swing HH/HL, D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.51, H1 above EMA9 9>21 at pos_in_day_range_pct 73.1, mp_state STRONG. The reaction is over; the new high is one close away. Pairs with TFX (C14).

trigger.plain: Let the back-up finish, then buy a daily close at a fresh new high above the pivot high.

decisions.wrong_if: A daily close back below structure_shift_ref (failure at the pivotal point, C20), or a one-day reaction of one atr_14d off a day's high (C7).
decisions.reason: W swing HH/HL above EMA9 9>21 is an established trend; D below EMA9 and H1 below EMA9 9<21 at pos_in_day_range_pct 2.3 is a back-up in progress. C5: I do not buy the back-up, only the new high after it.

trigger.plain: Buy only a daily close at a fresh new high above the pivot high, ending the reaction.

decisions.wrong_if: A one-day reaction of one atr_14d off a day's high (C7, translated), or a daily close below entry less one atr_14d.
decisions.reason: W swing HH/HL with close_vs_swing_high_pct 20.92 is a strong trend; D close_vs_swing_high_pct -4.96 is a normal reaction, H1 at pos_in_day_range_pct 94.2. No new high yet, so wait for it (C5). Judged on its own, not the group.

declarations: danger_signal_threshold: TRANSLATED via atr_14d (one atr_14d off the day's high), my own translation, not Livermore's literal 6 points (C7, C18-C20).
R1: no bracket field is a basis for any decision. Buy words are new-high words only; never in_zone or reclaim (C5).
